prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: mypy 2>&1 | tail -40; cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files
cd src/trailhead; cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; git log --stat | head -20; grep -n "None\|elevation" -r ../../tests README.md ../../README.md plan.py cli.py geo.py | head -80
cd ../..; sed -n 20,60p README.md; cat src/trailhead/plan.py tests/conftest.py; grep -rn "ele\b" src/trailhead/cli.py src/trailhead/plan.py

python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/trailhead/track.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
''','''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())

    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the missing ones filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track where no
        point has an elevation is a `TrackError`.
        """
        first = next((p.ele for p in self.points if p.ele is not None), None)
        if first is None:
            raise TrackError("no point of the track has an elevation")
        filled: list[float] = []
        last = first
        for point in self.points:
            if point.ele is not None:
                last = point.ele
            filled.append(last)
        return filled
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/elevation.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]","elevations = track.elevations()")
s=s.replace("""    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):
        if km == 0:
            continue
        steepest = max(steepest, abs(b.ele - a.ele) / (km * 1000) * 100)""","""    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):
        if km == 0:
            continue
        steepest = max(steepest, abs(b - a) / (km * 1000) * 100)""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/pace.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("counted_changes([p.ele for p in track.points])","counted_changes(track.elevations())")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/report.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("gain_and_loss([point.ele for point in track.points], threshold)","gain_and_loss(track.elevations(), threshold)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; mypy; ruff check . | tail -5; pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; cat src/trailhead/cli.py | sed -n 25,45p
printf 'lat,lon,ele\n42.0,23.0,\n42.001,23.0,100\n42.002,23.0,\n42.003,23.0,130\n' > $TMPDIR/t.csv; python -m trailhead $TMPDIR/t.csv 2>&1 || PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead $TMPDIR/t.csv
